text:
# 将主动获客与SEO、GEO并行建设

- 作者：Flavio Amiel（@fba）
- 原帖发布时间：2026-03-24 22:34（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/fba/status/2036451492853395481
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29

## 中文全文

每天主动获客 8 小时。

陌生私信、开发邮件、Reddit、LinkedIn，循环往复。

我见过这种路线，也看过它把创始人消耗殆尽。

只要停一周，销售机会就归零。

我合作过 30+ 家 SaaS 公司。

那些停滞不前的公司，把一切都建立在主动获客上。

而那些做到 $50K 月度经常性收入（MRR）、并继续增长的公司呢？

它们都想明白了同一件事：

你需要一个在睡觉时也能运转的渠道。

凌晨 2 点仍然排名 #1 的落地页。

6 个月前的文章，如今每月仍带来 500 次访问。

顺便说一句，我不是说主动获客有问题。主动获客很好，但当它与第二个渠道搭配时，压力就会减轻。

我见过有效的组合是：

第 1–12 个月：通过主动获客拿到首批客户。

第 3–12 个月：并行建设 SEO 和 GEO。

从第 6／12+ 个月开始：自然流量承担很大一部分获客任务，主动获客可以变为可选项，或者你拥有两个都在显著增长的渠道。

建立一个不需要你 24/7 守着的渠道。

---

## 英文原文

8 hours of outbound a day.

Cold DMs. Cold emails. Reddit. LinkedIn. Repeat.

I've seen this blueprint. I've watched it burn founders out.

Miss one week and your pipeline goes to zero.

I've worked with 30+ SaaS companies.

The ones that stall out built everything on outbound.

The ones that hit $50K MRR and kept going? 

They all figured out the same thing:

You need a channel that works while you sleep.

A landing page ranking #1 at 2am. 

A post from 6 months ago still pulling 500 visits a month.

BTW, I am not saying outbound is a problem. Outbound is wonderful, but when you pair it with a second channel, the stress eases out.

The formula that I've seen working:

Months 1–12: outbound to get first customers

Months 3–12: build SEO and GEO in parallel

From Month 6/12+: organic carries a lot of the weight, outbound coould become optional (or have two big growing channels)

Build a channel that doesn't need you 24/7
